from pathlib import Path


class Store:
    def __init__(self, folder):
        self.folder = Path(folder)

    # flowguard: event SAVED
    def save(self, artifact_id: str) -> None:
        (self.folder / artifact_id).write_text("data")

    # flowguard: event PUBLISHED
    def publish(self, artifact_id: str) -> None:
        (self.folder / ("pub-" + artifact_id)).write_text("published")


def needs_save(artifact_id: str) -> bool:
    return not artifact_id.startswith("tmp")


# flowguard: event ENTRY
def release(store, artifact_id: str) -> None:
    if needs_save(artifact_id):
        store.save(artifact_id)
    store.publish(artifact_id)
